title: Write, read, and overwrite
prompt: Implement `static void WriteNote(string path, string note)` (create parent directory if missing, overwrite the file with the note text) and `static string ReadNote(string path)` (return the file's text; `FileNotFoundException` when the file doesn't exist).

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Write must create missing directories and replace existing content.

tests.name: missing
tests.hint: Reading what was never written is an exceptional condition.
